'''Tweak Set''' is a Players Committee errata package published with numbered virtual sets. It is not a numbered Virtual Set.

[[Virtual Set 26]] was released with a combined errata PDF.<ref name="vs26errata" />

== Tweak Set 2026 ==
On 8 March 2026 at 9:06 PM EDT (9 March 2026 UTC), [[Tweak Set]] 2026 went live on [[GEMP]] following an 8:00 PM Eastern shutdown, with its PDF hosted on the errata tab of the Players Committee virtual slips page.<ref name="slack-tweak26" /> An accompanying GEMP charity tweaking event launched on 10 March 2026 (9 March UTC/EDT transition) and raised nearly $800 for charity ahead of start of play.<ref name="slack-tweak26-ch" />
